kjv: take heed to thyself (David) until the morning
mine: be on your (David's) guard in the morning
note: Hebrew babboqer means "in the morning". The danger comes at morning (cf. v. 11), not up to it.

kjv: took an image ... a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster
mine: took the household idol ... a net of goats' hair at its head
note: hatterafim are household gods, man-sized here. kevir ha'izzim (a hapax) is probably a goat-hair net or quilt placed at the head to look like hair.
